title: How a pool is built
caption: You just built a pool 🏊 Every layer has a job. #howitsbuilt #pool #construction #howitworks #learnontiktok

lines.text: If you want a *pool* in your backyard, you dig a hole.
But the dirt walls cave in the second they get wet.
So you line the hole with a cage of steel *rebar*.
Then you blast concrete onto it at high speed.
That's called *gunite*, and it hardens into one solid shell.
But concrete is full of tiny holes, so the water slowly leaks out.
So you coat it in *plaster*, which seals it smooth.
Then you cap the edges with stone, so nobody scrapes their feet.
Now you fill it up.
But still water turns *green* within days, because algae starts growing in it.
So you put a drain at the bottom and a *skimmer* at the top, and pipe them both to a *pump*.
The pump pushes the water through a *filter* that traps leaves and dirt, then sends it back through jets in the walls.
But a filter can't kill algae.
So you add *chlorine*.
But sunlight breaks chlorine down in just a few hours.
So you add *stabilizer*, which shields it from the sun.
And the water is freezing.
So you add a *heater*.
And at night you can't see the bottom, so you add a *light*.
Congratulations, you just built a *pool*.
